scientific_integrity: The all-length result is supported by an explicit phase/quartet proof and independently replayable finite checks; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only contiguous factor frequencies for the explicitly defined generalized period-doubling words; no individual occurrence-set classification and no transfer to arbitrary automatic words. General frequency bounds, unweighted dyadic factor counts, and binary reflection counts are prior results. Bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed sources; finite computational checks alone do not certify the infinite theorem.
title: Exact all-length factor-frequency spectra of generalized period-doubling words
